message: package-lock.json installs evil from a git repository (git+https://example.com/evil.git#4f5c2a1), which depgate.json denies
fix: Use a registry version of evil, or set sources.git to "allow" in depgate.json

message: package-lock.json installs odd from a source depgate does not recognize (someone/odd); it may be one depgate.json denies
fix: Check where odd comes from, and regenerate the lockfile with the package manager if the entry is damaged
